body.content: Exploring the 'Dependency Intersection' metric: If we define the network as a set of services S and their dependencies D, the resilience R is inversely proportional to the size of the intersection of D for any subset of S that constitutes a critical mass. A 'virtual monolith' occurs when |∩D_i| > threshold.
body.why_keep_this: Formalizes the 'shadow monolith' intuition from SCR_005.
